terra.problem: Pilate is identified as the Roman governor, but Mark 15:2 does not give that title. The identification needs a reference to a passage that does.
Saying the crowd was worked up assigns them an emotional state. The text says the chief priests stirred them up to seek Barabbas’s release, not how they felt.
Saying Pilate’s question turned the volume up gives a reason for the louder shouting that the text does not state.
The soldiers’ full salute is not the same as Pilate’s question. Both use the title King of the Jews, but Pilate does not say the soldiers’ words.
